# Native BUH Boolean constant

The unchanged Constant.xml and compressed owner resource were retained from the existing native CF/XML export. No database was contacted for this review. The two common-attribute XML and compressed resources independently retain their conditional constant UUID.

The measured profile is class14/12 (including final Atom0), body27/23, typed2/3, strict identity1/7, Pattern[B]. profile.json was generated from the raw tree. The initial prose miscounted class length as11; native positive tests rejected that guard, and final code/OpenSpec use12. The public native test additionally exposed the missing streaming class14 preflight. Neither synthetic header normalization nor serialized reclassification is used.

Only Boolean without qualifiers/reference is recognized. Generated Manager and ValueManager pairs match XML; no ValueKey offset or additional settings are inferred. Existing strict identity and Pattern helpers are reused unchanged.
